June 15, 2026
VIA ONLINE FILING - Labor and Workforce Development Agency
VIA CERTIFIED MAIL - Pacific Coast Fresh, Inc.
Re: Notice of Labor Code Violations Pursuant to the Private Attorneys General Act (Labor Code section 2699.3) on behalf of Maria Sanchez
Ms. Sanchez worked as a packer. Defendant failed to provide compliant meal periods because supervisors required work through lunch on busy days, in violation of Labor Code sections 226.7 and 512. Defendant failed to authorize and permit rest periods (section 226.7). Defendant did not pay overtime at the correct regular rate because it excluded production bonuses (sections 510, 1194). Defendant failed to reimburse cell phone expenses (section 2802) and failed to provide accurate wage statements (section 226).
